AJUP Chief Humayun Kabir Detained During Rejinagar Bypoll

Humayun Kabir, chief of the AJUP party, was detained during the Rejinagar by-election. Reports indicate the detention occurred after Kabir engaged in an argument with police while voting. One outlet states he was arrested over allegations of trying to influence voters, while another reports he was detained after alleging police interference. He was reportedly taken directly from his office to be detained.
